thread.title: python get max value from multiple dataframes

author: tony
title: python get max value from multiple dataframes
text:
I am trying to calculate the Average True Range (ATR) for multiple stocks. ATR is calculated by getting the MAX of 3 values and then calculating its moving average: Range1 = abs(High - Low) Range2 = abs(High - Previous Close) Range3 = abs(Low - Previous Close)
Because I have multiple stocks, I have separated the High, Low, Close prices into separate dataframes (df_High, df_Low, df_Close), which look like this:
Date | AAPL | MSFT | ETC...
From these 3 dataframes, I calculate and create 3 new time series dataframes (df_Range1, df_Range2, df_Range3).
My question is: how do I get the MAX of (df_Range1, df_Range2, df_Range3) and store it as a new time series dataframe (df_MaxRange) with the columnn names as above: Date | AAPL | MSFT | ETC...
Is separating the High, Low, Close prices in separate dataframes a good way to tackle this? Or would there be a better way to do this? Having multiple stocks in the dataframe seems to complicate this.
Thanks for your advice.
